system.description:
1 Action, Reach: 8, Damage: Soul power. Deal Cold damage and inflict Soul Touched. Deal no damage when targeting an ally.

Your soul power scales as you level:

  • Level 1 — soul power is 1d8.

  • Level 5 (Soul Twist 2) — soul power is 2d8.

  • Level 10 (Soul Twist 3) — soul power is 3d8.

  • Level 15 (Soul Twist 4) — soul power is 4d8.

  • Level 20 (Master of the Veil) — soul power is 5d8.

Soul power is also the damage/temp-HP value referenced by Soul Rite and many Soul Sculpting techniques.

[A] Rolls your soul power ((LVL÷5 rounded down + 1)d8) as Cold damage; the damage button only applies to hostile targets, so twisting an ally deals no damage.

[A] Every target is marked Soul Touched: a “Soul Touched (your name)” effect appears on it (the token also shows Nimble's Marked status icon); anyone can delete that effect by hand to clear a mistaken mark.

[A] Free Soul Twists (Soul Taker, Bloodsong) and Dying Surge make this cost 0 Actions automatically.
